subject: Vendor profile curation — gateway cutover plan & SOC2 mapping
messages:
From: Amelia Ross <amelia@brightforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@brightforge.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Initial: SIG/CAIQ mapping questions + onboarding cadence

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're getting our security intake lined up for the vendor portal work and want to confirm a few things before we kick off:

1) Which portal do you prefer for BrightForge: Vendr or Whistic? We currently use Vendr but can mirror to Whistic if needed.
2) We have a small SOC 2 sample we can share; can you confirm how Redwood prefers SOC2 artifacts to be uploaded (S3 presigned vs direct portal upload)?
3) Attached is our internal SIG gap summary (BrightForge_SIG_GapSummary.xlsx) — can your team map the SIG rows to Redwood's CAIQ equivalents and indicate evidence possession?

Goal: we want a clean migration so our CMDB shows Redwood's profile as complete before vendor review week (first week of June).

Thanks — can you propose a short cutover window?

Best,
Amelia Ross\Security Lead, BrightForge
attachments: BrightForge_SIG_GapSummary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia@brightforge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: SIG/CAIQ mapping questions + onboarding cadence

Hi Amelia —

Appreciate the gap summary. High level proposal below so we can align teams and keep the first-week-of-June target: 

Cutover plan (proposed):
- Pre-work (this week): Redwood fills out a CAIQ export and pre-seeds Vendr with metadata we control. We will flag controls where we require your uploaded evidence.
- Migration window (2-hour window, Wed 2026-05-27 10:00–12:00 PT): sync S3 presigned uploads for large artifacts, validate whitelisted URLs in the portal, and flip the gateway pointer so Vendr becomes the canonical profile.
- Post-cutover (3 business days): evidence validation pass and SOC2 sample delivery.

Action items (owners):
- Redwood: provide vendr-mapping-template.csv and CAIQ export (Ben / Jonas)
- BrightForge: seed controls that require customer-supplied artifacts (Amelia)
- Evidence rotation owner: Mina to manage SOC2 sample ingestion and rotation cadence

I attached a simple Vendr mapping template to speed mapping. If that timeline works, Mina and Jonas will run the technical kickoff and I'll loop in Jordan for procurement/contract alignment if any DocuSign is needed.

Thanks —
Ben
Senior Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-vendr-mapping-template.csv (csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: SIG/CAIQ mapping questions + onboarding cadence

Quick technical notes for the migration window: 

- We will provision a staging S3 bucket (redwood-vendr-staging-brightforge) and generate presigned POST URLs for documents >10MB. This prevents portal timeouts during large artifact ingest.
- Service account: Redwood will create a least-privilege service account for the sync with a 90-day key rotation; we'll share the IAM role and short-lived creds via a secure share.
- Filename conventions: please include the CAIQ control id in filenames (e.g., CAIQ-1.2.3-penetration-report.pdf) to make the mapping deterministic.

I uploaded a short playbook to the shared Drive for the presign flow: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_gateway-cutover-plan

Attachments: s3-presign-playbook.md (text)

—Jonas
Platform Integrations, Redwood Inference
